findings.claim: Both reviewers: the narrowed mappingKey no longer stops an unclosed quote at a top-level key with a value. Answered with evidence: frontmatter.go:96 breaks on any line that does not start with a space or tab, so a top-level key (license: x, name: y) still ends the value; the case a quote that never closes keeps its first line (description "a / b / license: x) passes, and the other keys after it are read passes.
